description: This file defines the SiloStatus enum representing various states of a silo in Orleans, along with extension methods for SiloStatus, specifically the IsTerminating method to check if a silo is in a terminating state.

classes.name: SiloStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible statuses of a silo in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloStatusExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for SiloStatus, such as checking if a silo is terminating.

methods.name: IsTerminating
methods.description: Extension method that returns true if the silo status indicates it is shutting down, stopping, or dead.
